description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - The Industrial Disputes between Tea Shakthi Fund & Mr. A. J. R. Senevirathne and three other notices
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains statutory instruments and legal procedures for dispute resolution between employers and employees, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a government minister (Ravindra Samaraweera), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
